verdict.rationale: Greptile lets users configure review triggers and PR filters (via the dashboard or a repo-level greptile.json), so PR events automatically start a review, and it can automatically route agent-authored PRs to a different model. The only action these rules can fire is a code review: custom rules define what to flag, not event-to-action automations. missing for 10: a general user-definable event→action rule engine, actions beyond running/routing reviews (e.g. auto-dispatching Fix with your Agent on events), detailed trigger documentation, independent corroboration.
